memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the Lord our God is near us whenever we pray to him? And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today? - Deut 4:7-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses asks a searching question: "What other nation is so great as to have their gods near them the way the Lord our God is near us whenever we pray to him?" This was Israel's unique privilege. The gods of the nations were distant, silent idols. But the living God was near to His people, hearing them whenever they called. And He had given them righteous laws that no other nation possessed. Israel was blessed above all peoples — not because they were greater, but because their God was near.

What a treasure this is: a God who draws near and hears our prayers. The nations bowed to gods who could not speak, see, or respond. But the true God is intimately present with His people, attentive to their cries. Nearness to God was Israel's greatest blessing, greater than any earthly advantage.

If Israel had this privilege under the old covenant, how much more do we enjoy it now in Christ. Through Jesus, God has drawn even nearer to His people. He is called Immanuel, "God with us" (Matt 1:23). Through the cross, the way into God's presence has been opened wide, and we are invited to approach the throne of grace with confidence (Heb 4:16). By His Spirit, God dwells within believers.

We must never take this for granted. The God of the universe is near to us, hears our every prayer, and welcomes us into His presence through Christ. When we feel far from God, the truth is that He is near — nearer than we know. Draw close to Him in prayer, for He has promised to draw close to us (Jas 4:8). What greater blessing could there be than a God who is near?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you treasure the nearness of God as your greatest blessing?
2. How does knowing God hears your every prayer change the way you pray?
3. How has Christ brought you even nearer to God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You are a God who draws near and hears me whenever I call. Help me treasure Your nearness above every earthly blessing, and to draw close to You in prayer, through Christ who is God with us. Amen.
